§6Storage Scanner§f

§aOne console to search every chest, crate, and storage block in your base.§f

The §bStorage Scanner§f indexes up to §e20 inventories§f in a radius, vanilla chests, iron chests, Modular Storage blocks, Drawer Controllers, you name it.

Open the GUI to search across everything at once. Double-click to request items into your inventory. By default, requested items route §ainto your player inventory§f, not an output slot.

§6Energy Costs§f:
§b• Insert§f: §e20 RF§f per item
§b• Request§f: §e100 RF§f per item
§b• Buffer§f: §e50,000 RF§f stored, §e500 RF/t§f input

§9Note:§f You can pipe items in and out of the Scanner with XNet or Thermal Dynamics conduits to automate the entire scanned network.
